value.answer: Here's what I found for Toronto. The free option is the Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program. It gives free CBT for depression and anxiety. You don't need an Ontario health card or a family doctor, and you can refer yourself at ontariohealth.ca/osp. An intake clinician checks whether it suits you, and it isn't right for everyone. Cheaper options include CAMH, the Gerstein Centre and the community health centres, which have low-cost or free counselling, plus the U of T and TMU training clinics, where supervised students see clients at reduced rates. The student clinic at 3910 Bathurst St is about $50 for 50 minutes, with a free 15-minute phone chat first. I couldn't confirm any of these are taking new clients right now, so call before you count on one. If things get urgent, go to the nearest emergency department.
